receptions.convert.denied: Converting a visit needs the reception conversion permission.
receptions.convert.unavailable: A visit is converted once it is authorized. Approve it first.
receptions.convert.alreadyDone: This visit has already been converted to a work order.
receptions.convert.replayed: This visit was already converted. The work order below is the one it produced — nothing was created twice.
receptions.convert.stateOpaque: The state is a code from the workshop’s own catalogue, so it is shown exactly as recorded.
receptions.convert.readDenied: The work order exists. Your access does not include reading work orders, so only what the conversion answered is shown.
receptions.convert.noJobs: The work order has no jobs on it yet.
receptions.acknowledgement.title: Reception acknowledgement
receptions.acknowledgement.description: The visit record, laid out for printing and for handing to the customer.
receptions.acknowledgement.footerNote: This sheet records what was reported and observed when the vehicle was received. It is not a diagnosis and not a quotation.
receptions.acknowledgement.sectionUnread: This section could not be read, so it is not printed here. That is not a statement that nothing is recorded — quote this reference when asking about it:
receptions.acknowledgement.truncated: One page of this section is printed. More is recorded than fits here; the full list is on the visit screen.
receptions.queue.title: Reception queue
receptions.queue.description: The vehicles this branch has received, most recently received first.
receptions.queue.idleBody: The queue is read for one branch at a time. Name the company and branch, then show the queue.
receptions.queue.caption: Reception visits for the chosen branch
receptions.queue.noneMatching: No reception visit in this branch matches what you asked for.
receptions.queue.orderingNote: Ordered by when the vehicle was received, newest first. The platform publishes no total, so none is shown.
receptions.queue.releaseVehicle: Open the visit to end it
workOrders.queue.title: Work orders
workOrders.queue.description: The work orders of this branch, most recently opened first.
workOrders.queue.formLabel: Choose a branch and narrow the work orders
workOrders.queue.stateFilterHelp: The state code as your workshop defines it. An unknown code returns nothing rather than an error.
workOrders.queue.stateFormat: A state code is lower-case letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter.
workOrders.queue.scopeUnrestricted: Your access is not restricted to particular branches, so enter the identifier of the one you want.
workOrders.queue.idleBody: A work-order board belongs to one branch. Nothing is requested until you name one.
workOrders.queue.resultsHeading: Work orders for the chosen branch
workOrders.queue.caption: Work orders for the chosen branch
workOrders.queue.noneMatching: No work order in this branch matches what you asked for.
workOrders.queue.orderingNote: Ordered by when the work order was opened, newest first. The platform publishes no total, so none is shown. A closed work order shows the customer of its own visit, which may differ from the vehicle’s current owner.
workOrders.queue.column.noCustomer: No customer recorded for this visit
workOrders.detail.title: Work order
workOrders.detail.description: What this work order is, where it may go next, and the jobs it holds.
workOrders.detail.lifecycleNote: The states offered here are the ones your workshop’s own graph allows from where this work order stands.
workOrders.detail.noNextStates: This work order has no next state. Its lifecycle has ended and it is frozen.
workOrders.detail.noTransitionPermission: Your access does not include moving this work order.
workOrders.detail.conflict: Someone changed this record after you opened it, so nothing was written. Reload and look again before repeating the action.
workOrders.detail.noJobsBody: This work order holds no job.
workOrders.detail.noDepartments: This branch has no department to route to.
workOrders.detail.departmentsUnavailable: The department list could not be read, so routing is unavailable.
workOrders.detail.noRoutingPermission: Your access does not include editing this job.
workOrders.detail.noAssignments: No technician is assigned to this job.
workOrders.detail.technicianProfileIdHin: The technician’s profile identifier. The platform decides whether they qualify for this job.
workOrders.detail.assignmentIncomplete: Name a technician and both ends of the window.
workOrders.detail.noAssignPermission: Your access does not include assigning technicians.
workOrders.detail.noTechnicianReadPermis: Your access does not include seeing who is assigned to this job.
technicians.workspace.title: My work
technicians.workspace.description: The jobs assigned to you, your clock, and your notes on each.
technicians.workspace.queueNote: Every job currently assigned to you is listed. This list is not paged.
technicians.workspace.emptyDescription: Nothing is assigned to you in this branch right now.
technicians.workspace.identityRefused: This job could not be confirmed as yours, so no action is offered.
technicians.workspace.notOwnAssignment: That job is not in your queue, so nothing was recorded.
technicians.workspace.notOwnSession: That session is not yours, so it was left alone.
technicians.workspace.laborNote: Start and end times are the server's. Nothing is recorded until the server confirms it.
technicians.workspace.noActiveSession: Your clock is not running on this job.
technicians.workspace.noSessions: No labour has been recorded on this job yet.
technicians.workspace.noLaborPermission: Your access does not include recording labour.
technicians.workspace.conflict: This record changed since you loaded it. Reload and try again.
technicians.workspace.correctNote: The original is kept; a corrected copy is recorded beside it.
technicians.workspace.workLogNote: Notes are free text and permanent. To amend one, add another.
technicians.workspace.noWorkLog: No notes on this job yet.
technicians.workspace.loggedAtHint: Leave empty to record it as now.
technicians.workspace.noWorkReadPermissi: Your access does not include reading this job's notes and evidence.
technicians.workspace.evidenceNote: A file bound here stays bound; it cannot be removed.
technicians.workspace.noEvidence: No evidence is bound to this job.
technicians.workspace.evidenceTypeHint: A short word for what the picture shows, such as before the repair, after the repair, or the part label.
technicians.workspace.noCategories: This workspace has no document category to capture under.
technicians.workspace.capturedPartial: The file was stored but not bound to this job. Try again.
diagnostics.catalogue.title: Inspection templates
diagnostics.catalogue.description: The inspection templates this workshop runs diagnostics against, and the versions each one has published.
diagnostics.catalogue.emptyBody: A template appears here once someone with catalogue rights creates it.
diagnostics.catalogue.noTypesBody: A template must belong to a diagnostic type, and this workshop has none configured yet. Approved types are set up by the platform owner; nothing is invented here.
diagnostics.catalogue.codeHint: Lowercase letters, digits and underscores. It cannot be changed later.
diagnostics.catalogue.name: Name
diagnostics.template.title: Inspection template
diagnostics.template.conflict: This template changed since you opened it. Reload and try again.
diagnostics.template.nothingChanged: Nothing to save: the name and status are unchanged.
diagnostics.template.noVersions: This template has no version yet. Open one to start authoring items.
diagnostics.template.unitHint: Required for a numeric answer, for example mm or bar.
diagnostics.template.unitRequired: A numeric item needs a unit.
diagnostics.job.title: Job diagnostics
diagnostics.job.description: The diagnostic reports on this job. Start one from a published template, answer its checklist, record what you find, and complete it.
diagnostics.job.noPublishable: No published template is available for this job. A template must be published before a diagnostic can start.
diagnostics.job.emptyBody: Start one above to record a checklist, measurements, fault codes, findings and recommendations for this job.
diagnostics.report.conflict: This report changed since you opened it. Reload and try again.
diagnostics.report.noCategories: No document category is available for evidence, so nothing can be attached.
diagnostics.report.evidenceTypeHint: A short label in your own words, for example brake pad wear photo.
diagnostics.report.capturedPartial: The file was stored but could not be bound to this report. Nothing was lost; try attaching it again.
workOrders.detail.noHistory: Nothing has happened on this work order yet.
workOrders.detail.noBlockers: No blocker has been raised on this job.
quality.queue.title: Quality control
quality.queue.description: The quality-control records of one branch. Open a record's work order to answer its checks, finalize it, and close the order.
quality.queue.heading: Records
quality.queue.emptyTitle: No quality-control record in this branch
quality.queue.emptyBody: A record appears here once someone opens quality control on a work order.
quality.queue.openOrder: Open the work order's quality and closure view
quality.closure.title: Quality and closure
quality.closure.conflict: This record changed since you opened it. Reload and try again.
quality.closure.eligible: This work order can be closed.
quality.closure.notEligible: This work order cannot be closed yet.
quality.closure.alreadyTerminal: This work order is already in a final state.
quality.closure.deferred: Not yet enforced by the platform:
quality.closure.inventoryBlocking: Stock this work order still holds blocks closure.
quality.closure.reworkNeedsClosed: Rework can be opened once the work order is closed.
quality.closure.noQcBody: Open one to answer the checks this workshop requires before closure.
quality.closure.leadTechnicianHint: Required when the rework is safety-critical. The technician profile reference.
quality.closure.noRework: No rework has been opened on this work order.
quality.closure.signOffByHint: The independent reviewer's technician profile, from this workshop's roster. The platform refuses the person who led the rework.
quality.closure.reopenNote: A closed work order is not reopened: every attempt is refused and kept on record with its reason. Continue the work with a rework order instead.
quality.closure.noReopen: No reopen attempt has been recorded.
quality.closure.noAdditionalWork: No additional work has been requested.
quality.closure.noApproval: No customer approval has been recorded.
quality.closure.decidingPartyHint: The party role reference of the customer contact who decided.
quality.closure.noClosureTarget: No closing state is reachable from where this work order stands.
quality.closure.closeBlocked: Closure is refused while a blocker above stands.
services.catalogue.title: Service catalogue
services.catalogue.description: The services your workshop offers, by code. Retired services stay listed and are marked as retired.
services.catalogue.searchTooLong: That is longer than a service name can be.
services.catalogue.categoriesRefused: Your access does not include the category list, so categories show as identifiers.
services.catalogue.categoriesUnavailable: The category list could not be read right now, so categories show as identifiers.
services.catalogue.categoriesTruncated: There are more categories than this list can show.
services.catalogue.branchIdHelp: Your access does not include the branch list, so enter the identifier of the branch to check.
services.catalogue.branchIdFormat: That is not a branch identifier.
services.catalogue.branchesRefused: The branch list could not be read, so enter the branch identifier instead.
services.catalogue.effectiveOnHelp: Only services with a published version covering this date.
services.catalogue.dateFormat: Enter a date as year, month and day.
services.catalogue.caption: Services in the catalogue
services.catalogue.noneMatching: No service matches what you asked for.
services.catalogue.orderingNote: Ordered by service code. The platform publishes no total, so none is shown. A retired service stays listed because work orders may still refer to it.
services.catalogue.column.name: Name
services.catalogue.unknownCategory: Category not in the loaded list
services.create.title: New service
services.create.needsCategory: A service must be filed under a category. Create one first.
services.create.codeHelp: Letters, digits, hyphens and underscores. It cannot be changed later.
services.create.codeFormat: A service code starts with a letter or digit and uses only letters, digits, hyphens and underscores.
services.create.name: Name
services.create.nameTooLong: That is longer than a name can be.
services.create.descriptionTooLong: That is longer than a description can be.
services.category.explain: Categories group the catalogue. A category's code cannot be changed once created.
services.category.codeHelp: Lower-case letters, digits and underscores. It cannot be changed later.
services.category.codeFormat: A category code starts with a lower-case letter and uses only lower-case letters, digits and underscores.
services.category.name: Category name
services.detail.title: Service
services.detail.description: One service, where it is offered, and its published versions.
services.detail.name: Name
services.detail.descriptionHelp: Leave this empty to remove the description.
services.detail.retiredNote: This service is retired. It stays on record and cannot be brought back.
services.detail.noManagePermission: Your access allows viewing this service but not changing it.
services.detail.conflict: Someone else changed this service first. Reload the page to see the latest, then try again.
services.detail.retireConfirm: Retiring is permanent. The service stays on record but can no longer be offered.
services.detail.retireAcknowledge: I understand this cannot be undone.
services.availability.heading: Where this service is offered
services.availability.explain: Availability is recorded per branch. The platform does not publish a list of it; to check a branch, use the catalogue's 'available at branch' filter.
services.availability.idHelp: Your access does not include the branch list, so enter the company and branch identifiers.
services.version.heading: Versions
services.version.explain: A service can be sold only through a published version. The platform does not publish a list of versions; a draft you create here can be published from here.
services.version.effectiveToHelp: Optional. The last day is not included.
services.version.rangeOrder: The end date must be after the start date.
services.version.notesTooLong: That is longer than the notes can be.
services.version.labourNote: Standard labour times on this draft:
pricing.list.title: Price lists
pricing.list.description: The price lists of your workshop, their versions and rules, and the price that applies for a service.
pricing.list.caption: Price lists, by code
pricing.list.none: There are no price lists yet.
pricing.list.bound: This screen shows up to 100 price lists. If your workshop has more, they are not listed here.
pricing.list.column.name: Name
pricing.create.title: New price list
pricing.create.codeHelp: Letters, digits, dashes and underscores, 2 to 63 characters. It cannot be changed later.
pricing.create.codeFormat: The code must start with a letter or digit and use only letters, digits, dashes and underscores (2 to 63 characters).
pricing.create.name: Name
pricing.create.nameTooLong: The name is limited to 200 characters.
pricing.create.currencyHelp: The three-letter currency code, for example JOD. It cannot be changed later.
pricing.create.currencyFormat: Enter a three-letter currency code in capital letters.
pricing.create.descriptionTooLong: The description is limited to 2000 characters.
pricing.detail.title: Price list
pricing.detail.description: Versions, rules and where this list applies.
pricing.detail.name: Name
pricing.detail.noManagePermission: Your access lets you view this price list but not change it.
pricing.detail.inactiveNote: This price list is inactive, so nothing can be added to it.
pricing.detail.conflict: Someone else changed this price list first. Reload the page to see the latest, then try again.
pricing.versions.heading: Versions
pricing.versions.explain: A version holds the rules. A draft can take rules; publishing freezes it and puts it in force from the date you give.
pricing.versions.none: This price list has no version yet.
pricing.versions.truncated: Only the latest 100 versions are shown.
pricing.versions.caption: Versions of this price list, newest first
pricing.version.effectiveFromHelp: Provisional: publishing sets the final date.
pricing.publish.heading: Publish a draft
pricing.publish.explain: Publishing needs publishing access for the whole workshop and at least one rule on the draft. A published version is frozen.
pricing.publish.noDraft: There is no draft to publish.
pricing.rules.heading: Rules of version
pricing.rules.choose: Choose a version above to see its rules.
pricing.rules.none: This version has no rule yet.
pricing.rules.truncated: Only the first 200 rules are shown.
pricing.rules.caption: Rules of the chosen version, in the order the server applies them
pricing.rules.specificityHelp: Specificity is decided by the server: the more precisely a rule names a branch, a company and a customer class, the higher it is, and it wins before priority is considered.
pricing.rules.refused: Your access does not include the rules of this version.
pricing.rules.unavailable: The rules could not be loaded right now.
pricing.rules.frozen: This version is not a draft, so its rules cannot change.
pricing.rule.heading: Add a rule
pricing.rule.explain: A rule prices one service on this draft. Leave company and branch empty for a rule that applies everywhere; that needs manage access for the whole workshop.
pricing.rule.amountFormat: Enter an amount of zero or more with up to 4 decimal places.
pricing.rule.taxClassHelp: Optional, and needs a company. Tax classes cannot be listed here yet.
pricing.rule.taxNeedsCompany: A tax class needs a company.
pricing.rule.priorityHelp: A whole number from 0 to 1,000,000. Higher wins among rules of equal specificity.
pricing.rule.priorityFormat: Enter a whole number between 0 and 1,000,000.
pricing.assignment.heading: Where this list applies
pricing.assignment.explain: An assignment makes this list the one used for a company, a branch or a customer class from a date. Leave all three empty for the whole workshop; that needs manage access for the whole workshop.
pricing.assignment.noRead: Existing assignments cannot be listed here yet; only new ones can be recorded.
pricing.assignment.effectiveToHelp: Optional. Must be after the start date.
pricing.assignment.rangeOrder: The end date must be after the start date.
pricing.lookup.heading: Look up a price
pricing.lookup.explain: The price that applies for a service at a branch on a date, as the server resolves it. Nothing is calculated on this screen.
pricing.lookup.taxRateHelp: A fraction of 1 as the server states it: 0.160000 means sixteen hundredths. It stays 0.000000 while no tax rate is recorded.
pricing.lookup.refused: Your access does not include price lookup.
pricing.lookup.failed: The server did not return a price for that request.
pricing.picker.serviceSearchHelp: Type the beginning of a code or name, then search and choose.
pricing.picker.servicesRefused: Your access does not include the service catalogue.
pricing.picker.searchFailed: The search could not be completed right now.
pricing.picker.servicesNotReadable: Your access does not include the service catalogue, so enter the service identifier.
pricing.common.identifierHelp: Enter the identifiers as your administrator gave them.
pricing.common.branchesRefused: Your access does not include the branch list, so enter identifiers.
pricing.common.classFormat: Use lower-case letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter.
pricing.common.classHelp: Optional. Lower-case letters, digits and underscores.
